title: Multiple onramps can have the same scriptPubKeyHash
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  Each onramp contract has `scriptPubKeyHash` address which users deposit to those addresses to bridge their BTC, the issue is that the code doesn't check to make sure different onramp contracts have the different `scriptPubKeyHash` address. This would create issues and have multiple impacts based on the off-chain relay implementation:  1.
